title: Matching Couples Lingerie Set — Both Pieces Included | Burgundy | Couples Gifts
description:
Most couples sets sell you a top in your size and bottoms in the same size, which means one of you ends up wearing something that does not fit. This set is sold as two independently sized pieces. Choose your size and your partner's size at checkout.

The set coordinates on color and trim rather than trying to look identical, which works better when the two of you do not have the same build. The camisole has adjustable straps and a relaxed fit; the briefs have an elasticated waistband that does not roll.

Ships in a gift box with tissue, so it can go out as a gift without any extra wrapping.

WHAT MAKES IT WORK
• Two independently sized pieces — order both sizes at checkout
• Coordinates on color and trim, so mixed sizes still look intentional
• Elasticated waistband on the briefs that does not roll
• Adjustable straps on the cami
• Gift box with tissue included

DETAILS
• Material: 90% Nylon, 10% Spandex with lace trim
• Color: Burgundy
• Closure: Pull-on cami; elasticated waistband on briefs
• Pattern: Solid with lace trim
• Origin: Made in China
• Care: Machine wash cold on a delicate cycle. Tumble dry low. Do not bleach.

FIT & SIZING
The cami has a relaxed fit. If you want it closer, size down. Briefs run true to size.
Cami: model is 5'8" (173 cm) with a 34" bust, wearing size S. Briefs: model is 5'11" (180 cm) with a 32" waist, wearing size M.

SIZING (body measurements)
Size | Bust | Underbust | Waist | Hip | Weight (lb) | Equivalent to
XS | 30–31 in | 26–27 in | 23–24 in | 33–34 in | 90–115 lb | US 0–2
S | 32–33 in | 28–29 in | 25–26 in | 35–36 in | 115–140 lb | US 4–6
M | 34–35 in | 30–31 in | 27–28 in | 37–38 in | 140–165 lb | US 8–10
L | 36–38 in | 32–34 in | 29–31 in | 39–41 in | 165–190 lb | US 12–14
XL | 39–41 in | 35–37 in | 32–34 in | 42–44 in | 190–215 lb | US 16–18

Sizing tips:
• Measure your underbust — the band directly under the bust, snug but not tight. This matters more than the bust measurement for anything with a bodysuit fit.
• Measure your hip at the widest point, roughly 8 inches below the waist. This is the number most people underestimate.
• If you are between sizes, size up for sleepwear and lounge pieces, and size down for fitted bodysuits where you want a close fit.
• Fabric stretch varies by style. Each product page lists how much give the fabric has — styles listed as "about 2 inches of stretch" will size down more easily.
• Between a standard size and an extended size? Take the standard size. The jump to extended sizing changes torso length and gusset volume, not just the measurements.

QUESTIONS WE GET A LOT
Q: How do I order if we are different sizes?
A: The set is two independently sized pieces. Choose your size and your partner's size separately at checkout — you do not have to buy two sets in the same size.

Q: Will the set look mismatched if we are different sizes?
A: No. The two pieces coordinate on color and trim rather than by identical cut, so different sizes still read as a matched set.

Q: Does this fit in a gift box?
A: It ships in a gift box with tissue paper, ready to hand over without extra wrapping.

Q: What occasions does this work for?
A: Anniversaries, weddings, Valentine's Day, and birthdays. It is also popular as a groomsman or bridesmaid-adjacent gift because the box looks considered.

Shipping: We ship from New Jersey. Orders are processed in 1-2 business days and typically arrive within 2-4 business days after dispatch. Orders over $59 ship free within the US.

Returns: We accept returns within 30 days, unworn with tags attached, and return shipping is on us. If you need a different size, message us with your measurements and we will help.

Support replies within 24 hours, every day of the week. care@lumencie.com
